title: Package metadata points users to placeholder repository URLs
reasoning: The published package metadata advertises GitHub URLs under github.com/example, while the README points users to an actual ghcr.io/azizmarashly image namespace. If this project is built and published, PyPI and other tooling will direct users to a non-owned placeholder repository for homepage, documentation, source, and issue reporting, which breaks support and provenance expectations for consumers.
recommendation: Replace the placeholder project URLs with the real repository, documentation, and issue tracker URLs before publishing the package.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are included for this metadata feature, and normal unit tests would not validate published package URLs unless an explicit metadata check is added.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a packaging metadata test that parses pyproject.toml and asserts project.urls do not contain github.com/example and match the documented project namespace.
